notes: If a candidate answers a question TWICE, only mark the FIRST attempt. If a candidate has crossed out an attempt of a question and not redone the question, mark the crossed out version. Consistent accuracy applies in ALL aspects of the marking memorandum. Stop marking at the second calculation error. Assuming answers/values in order to solve a problem is NOT acceptable. Next to each tick that is indicated, the mark allocation is also indicated as S (statement) or R (reason). A mark for a correct statement (a statement mark is independent of a reason). A mark for the correct reason (a reason mark may only be awarded if the statement is correct). Award a mark if statement AND reason are both correct (S/R).

$\dfrac{\sin 140^{\circ}\cdot\sin(360^{\circ}-x)}{\cos 50^{\circ}\cdot\tan(-x)}$

$=\dfrac{\sin 40^{\circ}(-\sin x)}{\sin 40^{\circ}(-\tan x)}$

$=\dfrac{-\sin x}{-\dfrac{\sin x}{\cos x}}$

$=\cos x$

$\mathrm{LHS}=\dfrac{-2\sin^2 x+\cos x+1}{1-\cos(540^{\circ}-x)}$ $\quad\mathrm{RHS}=2\cos x-1$

$\mathrm{LHS}=\dfrac{-2(1-\cos^2 x)+\cos x+1}{1-(-\cos x)}$

$\mathrm{LHS}=\dfrac{-2+2\cos^2 x+\cos x+1}{1+\cos x}$

$\mathrm{LHS}=\dfrac{2\cos^2 x+\cos x-1}{1+\cos x}$

$\mathrm{LHS}=\dfrac{(2\cos x-1)(\cos x+1)}{1+\cos x}$

$\mathrm{LHS}=2\cos x-1$

$\therefore\mathrm{LHS}=\mathrm{RHS}$

In $\triangle\mathrm{SQR}$:

$\dfrac{\mathrm{QS}}{\sin x}=\dfrac{\mathrm{QR}}{\sin(90^{\circ}+x)}$

$\dfrac{\mathrm{QS}}{\sin x}=\dfrac{5}{\cos x}$

$\mathrm{QS}=\dfrac{5\sin x}{\cos x}$

$\mathrm{QS}=5\tan x$

$\dfrac{\mathrm{QT}}{\sin(180^{\circ}-2x)}=\dfrac{\mathrm{TS}}{\sin x}$

$\dfrac{\mathrm{QT}}{\sin 2x}=\dfrac{5\tan x}{\sin x}$

$\mathrm{QT}=\dfrac{5\tan x\sin 2x}{\sin x}$

$\mathrm{QT}=\dfrac{5\left(\dfrac{\sin x}{\cos x}\right)(2\sin x\cos x)}{\sin x}$

$\mathrm{QT}=\dfrac{5\sin x(2\sin x)}{\sin x}$

$\mathrm{QT}=10\sin x$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$\mathrm{QT}^2=\mathrm{QS}^2+\mathrm{TS}^2-2\cdot\mathrm{QS}\cdot\mathrm{TS}\cos Q\hat{S}T$

$\mathrm{QT}^2=(5\tan x)^2+(5\tan x)^2-2(5\tan x)(5\tan x)\cos(180^{\circ}-2x)$

$\mathrm{QT}^2=50\tan^2 x-50\tan^2 x(-\cos 2x)$

$\mathrm{QT}^2=50\tan^2 x(1+\cos 2x)$

$\mathrm{QT}^2=50\tan^2 x(1+2\cos^2 x-1)$

$\mathrm{QT}^2=50\tan^2 x(2\cos^2 x)$

$\mathrm{QT}^2=100\dfrac{\sin^2 x}{\cos^2 x}(\cos^2 x)$

$\mathrm{QT}^2=100\sin^2 x$

$\mathrm{QT}=10\sin x$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$\mathrm{TS}^2=\mathrm{QS}^2+\mathrm{TQ}^2-2\cdot\mathrm{QS}\cdot\mathrm{TQ}\cos x$

$(5\tan x)^2=(5\tan x)^2+\mathrm{TQ}^2-2(5\tan x)\cdot\mathrm{TQ}\cdot\cos x$

$0=\mathrm{TQ}^2-2(5\tan x)\cdot\mathrm{TQ}\cdot\cos x$

$0=\mathrm{TQ}\bigl[\mathrm{TQ}-10\tan x\cos x\bigr]$

$\mathrm{TQ}=10\tan x\cos x$ ($\mathrm{TQ}\neq 0$)

$=10\dfrac{\sin x}{\cos x}\cdot\cos x$

$=10\sin x$
